answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked bond that only matures after sustained useful work, like an island that admits newcomers only if they plant a juniper sapling and tend it until it becomes timber. A single identity earns full voting weight slowly, so an attacker spawning thousands of fakes must lock capital and wait the same long maturation period for each one, making a sybil swarm far more expensive than the influence it buys.
